sources.notes: Canonical binary was unavailable from the official host. No canonical SHA-256 is claimed. sources.title: IPL 2025 closed overseas-marker interpretation
sources.notes: Applies only to ipl-2025 retained-player rows. A '*' directly establishes OVERSEAS. An unmarked row establishes INDIAN as POLICY_DERIVED only after the official legend, all 46 rows, all 10 markers and every team total reconcile without conflict. Canonical binary and pixel verification were unavailable and are not claimed.

sources.title: Bounded IPL registration country-to-roster interpretation
sources.notes: For only the approved 2022-2026 pilot locators, an official IPL Country/State Association or equivalent registration designation may support a POLICY_DERIVED roster status when paired with season roster evidence. This is an offline evidence assertion, never a runtime nation-to-status inference. Missing, conflicting or unusual registration cases require manual review.
